page.overview:
Who is Bobby Scott?

Bobby Scott (born Robert William Scott, January 29, 1937 – November 5, 1990) was an American musician, record producer, and songwriter. His song A Taste of Honey, co-written with Ric Marlow, was covered by The Beatles and released on their first album, Please Please Me.
